title: Alto System Project: Larry Tesler demonstration of Gypsy
summary: Archival footage of Larry Tesler demonstrating Gypsy, the modeless text editor he and Tim Mott built at Xerox PARC, running on the Computer History Museum's restored Alto. It is a long hands-on walkthrough of one of the earliest graphical document editors.
why: Referenced in discussions of early GUIs and Alto history as a rare first-hand demonstration by the creator.

quote.text: In 2017 Tesler recorded a demo with the Computer History Museum on their restored Alto
